subject: Renewal: Priority SLA + On-call Roster and Term Extension
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.inference>
To: Carlos Medina <carlos@oliverobotics.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal: Priority SLA + On-call Roster and Term Extension

Hi Carlos —

Hope you had a good week. Olive's annual renewal is coming up on 2027-01-15 and I wanted to propose a path for upgrading to our Priority (Premium) SLA and adding the operational coverage you've asked for. High-level proposal: 

- Term: 12-month renewal with a one-time option to extend to 24 months at a blended discount (details in the draft).
- SLA: P95 latency target 150ms for text-generation routes, with agreed latency measurement windows and monthly reports.
- Support: Priority queue (4-hour initial response for sev2, 30-minute on-call RTO for sev1 during business hours), dedicated Technical Account Manager (TAM).
- Capacity: Reserved baseline +20% burst capacity for peak manufacturing runs (see attached Q3 capacity report).

I've attached a draft SLA (redwood_premium_sla_draft_v3.pdf) and our suggested change log. If this looks directionally correct, I'd like to schedule a 30-minute alignment call this week to confirm pricing and finalize DocuSign by end of next week.

Next steps I propose:
1) You review the draft and mark any non-starters
2) We confirm pricing and reserved capacity sizing (Ben can walk through numbers)
3) Legal/counterpart sign — target 2026-12-10 for signature to ensure onboarding before renewal date.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this in place so Olive has guaranteed capacity for the January rollout.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
T: +1 415-555-0123
redwood.inference
From: Carlos Medina <carlos@oliverobotics.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.inference>
Cc: Maya Singh <maya.s@oliverobotics.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 11:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: Priority SLA + On-call Roster and Term Extension

Tessa —

Thanks for the clear summary and the draft. A few quick reactions from our side:

- The latency P95 target is reasonable, but we need clarity on measurement (regions, request types). Can you confirm the measurement windows and whether burst traffic counts against the P95?
- Budget is tight for Q1; do you have a simple pricing delta (monthly $) for the Priority SLA + the +20% reserved capacity? We may need to trade term length for lower near-term spend.
- On-call RTO sounds great, but we need at least two named contacts on your side for escalation.

Maya and I reviewed the capacity report and it looks fine. We're happy to do a call — Thursday 10am PT works. Also can we get a 30–60 day trial of the reserved capacity (instrumented) so we can validate during the January workload?

— Carlos
VP Operations, Olive Robotics
ops@oliverobotics.com

>

Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 13:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: Priority SLA + On-call Roster and Term Extension

Carlos/Maya —

Quick answers to the technical points before our call:

- Measurement: P95 will be computed on the production ingress in the primary region (us-west-2) at the route level. Bursts are included; however, reserved capacity helps reduce queuing tail. We can provide monthly measurement windows and a CSV export for the first 90 days.
- Pricing delta: Priority SLA + TAM + +20% reserve is roughly +$12,500/month on top of your current committed spend. If Olive prefers a lower ARR impact, we can extend to a 24-month term and reduce that to +$9,000/month. I'll bring a one-page pricing matrix to the call.
- On-call contacts: Myself (Ben Carter, Support Lead) and Evelyn Hart (Operations Manager) will be on the escalation roster; both can be named in the MSA addendum.
- Trial: We can enable a 60-day instrumented reserved pool that will behave like the production reserve (metered). During that period we'll provide telemetry and a health check at 30 days.

Attaching the pricing matrix and the draft SLA with line notes. We'll review on Thursday 10am PT — meeting invite sent.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Support & Solutions, Redwood Inference
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.inference>
To: Carlos Medina <carlos@oliverobotics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.inference>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 03 Dec 2026 16:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: Priority SLA + On-call Roster and Term Extension

Carlos —

Appreciate the quick review and the good questions. Short summary and next steps after today's call: 

- Measurement: confirm P95 measured per-route in us-west-2; bursts included. Monthly CSV export and dashboard access provided.
- Pricing: base estimate +$12.5k/month; 24-month term option drops to +$9k/month. See HubSpot deal for the updated quote.
- On-call roster: Ben and Evelyn named; TAM assignment pending final signature.
- Trial: 60-day instrumented reserved pool starts on activation — we'll schedule the activation window for 2027-01-03 to cover your January peak.

I've attached the final redline-ready SLA (redwood_premium_sla_draft_v3.pdf) and the capacity worksheet (oliverobotics_capacity_report_q3.xlsx). I pushed the updated pricing into HubSpot and generated a DocuSign envelope: https://na1.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?env=na1&v=2&gid=abcd-1234. 

If you can sign by 2026-12-10 we will allocate the reserved pool and confirm TAM onboarding prior to the renewal. Please let me know if you want legal on the call or prefer a stand-alone review.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_premium_sla_draft_v3.pdf (pdf, 312KB) — draft SLA with measurement windows and SLOs\oliverobotics_capacity_report_q3.xlsx (xlsx, 48KB) — recent usage and peak forecasts
